# TPC-Havoc Q2_v10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  s_acctbal,
  CASE WHEN NOT s_name IS NULL THEN s_name ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS s_name,
  CASE WHEN NOT n_name IS NULL THEN n_name ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS n_name,
  p_partkey,
  CASE WHEN NOT p_mfgr IS NULL THEN p_mfgr ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS p_mfgr,
  CASE WHEN NOT s_address IS NULL THEN s_address ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS s_address,
  CASE WHEN NOT s_phone IS NULL THEN s_phone ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS s_phone,
  CASE WHEN NOT s_comment IS NULL THEN s_comment ELSE '' END AS s_comment
FROM part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region
WHERE
  p_partkey = ps_partkey
  AND s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
  AND p_size = CASE WHEN 15 > 0 THEN 15 ELSE 1 END
  AND p_type LIKE CASE WHEN NOT '%BRASS' IS NULL THEN '%BRASS' ELSE '%' END
  AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey
  AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey
  AND r_name = CASE WHEN NOT 'EUROPE' IS NULL THEN 'EUROPE' ELSE r_name END
  AND ps_supplycost = (
    SELECT
      MIN(CASE WHEN ps_supplycost > 0 THEN ps_supplycost ELSE 999999 END)
    FROM partsupp, supplier, nation, region
    WHERE
      p_partkey = ps_partkey
      AND s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
      AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey
      AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey
      AND r_name = 'EUROPE'
  )
ORDER BY
  s_acctbal DESC,
  CASE WHEN NOT n_name IS NULL THEN n_name ELSE 'ZZZZZ' END,
  CASE WHEN NOT s_name IS NULL THEN s_name ELSE 'ZZZZZ' END,
  p_partkey
```
